title: Copilot setup cache restores must mirror lint.yml keys and paths; restore-only
answers: copilot setup cache miss or restore not hitting
change a lint cache key or path in the copilot setup steps
why does copilot agent setup reinstall pre-commit hooks
add a cache restore to copilot-setup-steps
body:
Invariant: the four restore steps in copilot-setup-steps.yml (action pins, mypy, install-bin, pre-commit hooks) must use the same path and key expressions that lint.yml saves, or restores silently miss.
Enforced by: .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml restore steps (actions/cache/restore keys and paths) and their counterparts in .github/workflows/lint.yml.
Restore-only: do not add an actions/cache save step to copilot-setup-steps.yml; lint.yml is the sole writer of these caches.
Setup-python here must keep pin-micro-version: false, matching lint.yml, so the interpreter matches the one the cached pre-commit environments were built under.
Breaks if skipped: key or path drift means all restores miss or hit with stale content, pre-commit rebuilds hook environments, and the agent setup time returns to roughly 48s.
applies: Only the Copilot setup steps workflow in mlflow/mlflow and its cache keys shared with lint.yml; not a general rule for other workflows.
says: Coding agent sessions take almost a minute to start because cached tools are missed.
The automated assistant rebuilds its code checking environment every time a session begins.
Speed up agent workspace startup by properly restoring cached dependencies and tools.
Assistant session setup has become noticeably slower and re-downloads tools from scratch.
Why does the coding agent reinstall all code analysis tools during environment initialization?
search: In .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml, the four cache restore steps for action pins, mypy, install-bin, and pre-commit hooks must exactly mirror the path and key expressions saved by .github/workflows/lint.yml. The setup workflow is restore-only and must never include cache save steps. In addition, setup-python must set pin-micro-version: false to match the interpreter under which lint.yml built the cached pre-commit environments. Skipping these alignments causes silent cache misses and forces pre-commit hook rebuilds that extend setup time to roughly 48 seconds.
